title: CUDA Books
summary: A curated GitHub repository listing excellent books for learning CUDA (Compute Unified Device Architecture), NVIDIA's parallel computing platform. The list is community-maintained and provides organized resources for developers looking to master GPU programming.
problem_solved: Solves the problem of finding quality, curated learning resources for CUDA programming by aggregating recommended books in one place.
why_valuable: It saves developers and researchers significant time in discovering the best CUDA learning materials, providing a vetted, community-approved reading list for mastering GPU programming.
